review_scope: Visual form and two static expression states of the disclosed digital prototype. This is not a motion, physical function or print-readiness verdict.
blind_held_read: A cute mint-green aquatic dragon or axolotl toy character with an expressive oversized face and segmented tapering body.
blind_form_read: Rounded bulbous head, broad pale flat face, separate rib-like mint body sections tapering to an upright pink branching tail. Dark conical dorsal and head spikes and pink fern-like external gills create the silhouette. Visible legs are chunky tapered mint shells with three dark claws apiece.
blind_subjects_read: A single creature shown with awake cheerful and sleeping peaceful expressions.
blind_action_read: Signature sheet shows the same resting body in two facial states: large open eyes and open smile on the left, curved closed eyes and small round mouth on the right. This clearly communicates an awake-to-sleep expression change, probably through alternative face pieces. It does not show the transition process or prove a mechanism.
blind_relationship_read: Head forward at lower left, body and dorsal cones receding to upper right, gills extending sideways near the head, and large branching tail at the rear. Two visible feet sit along the near side. Their upper flat caps remain visibly separate-looking and lack an obvious continuous connection to the body in this view; opposite side is occluded.
anti_generic_signature_read: A friendly pet-like aquatic dragon with two moods, combining axolotl gills and a segmented spiny dragon body. The switch from smiling awake to asleep is the strongest visible interaction in the signature sheet.
action_judgment_scope: The happy and sleepy exact installed states visibly communicate the face-expression change. This true visual judgment does not certify physical swapping, magnetic retention, friction, snapping, pose holding or joint travel. No movement is shown or passed.

post_reveal_supplemental_evidence.observation: Four bilaterally arranged paws and twelve claws are visible. Inward leg necks meet their owning barrel sections; the top-view suspicion of detached legs is resolved by this unchanged-geometry underside view. Lower plates lie on the body underside; several are edge-on.

Below/rear view exposes inward bent legs connected at the body flanks and the separate lower belly plates. The spare face back visibly contains three circular recesses. The cream patches are darkened by underside lighting. Coupon pieces and spare plate remain separate kit items, not a base.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Low, bulbous, chubby mint axolotl-dragon quadruped with a big head.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind read identified an aquatic dragon/axolotl with oversized rounded head, mint body and chunky paws. Supplemental underside view establishes four paws.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Rounded ellipse-like head mass, not a box or a sphere; broad cheek face at its front with backward lean.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind read identified a rounded bulbous head with broad mask-like face. Its lengthwise rounded mass is neither box-like nor a simple exposed sphere; hero profile shows the face raked back. Exact ellipse sections and 12-degree angle need CAD evidence.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Cream cheek-shaped removable-looking face plate seated inside a head rim.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind read identified a broad pale flat face; both signature states show the same cheek outline inside the mint edge. The kit hero contains a matching spare plate. Magnet retention is not inferred.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Eight distinct convex mint barrels taper backward from head toward raised tail, separated for articulation.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind read identified separate rib-like body sections tapering to the tail. The visible chain has eight progressively smaller sections and rounded flanks. Required centers, sections and permitted shortening are dimensional CAD matters.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: One cream belly plate per body segment on the underside.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Initial blind hero view occluded the underside. Post-reveal bottom and rear-oblique images show separate lower patches along the eight segments, broad in front and smaller at the raised rear; colors are muted by underside lighting.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Four bent mint legs, front and rear pairs, fixed if not articulated.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind hero read saw two near-side foot shells with uncertain attachment. Post-reveal bottom and rear-oblique images show all four legs and their inward bends meeting the body. Fixed construction is disclosed by the source; stills do not prove bond strength.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Four paws form the ground stance, with no base plate.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Bottom view shows four flat sole faces in paired placement; hero shows a free-standing animal with no display base. Exact Z=0/no-below-ground requirements are separately measured, not visually certified.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Three tapered charcoal claws on each paw.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Three dark claws are visible on each near paw in the blind images; post-reveal bottom image shows all twelve at the four paw fronts.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Three coral feather gills per side, upper, middle and lower, extending laterally.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind read identified fern-like pink external gills bracketing the head. Three graduated branches are visible on the near side and their mirrored counterparts on the far side; their tips extend wider than body and paws.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Gill leaves taper, have barb slots on both edges and raised shafts.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind images visibly show tapered branching leaves, alternating edge cuts and a raised central shaft on exposed faces. Exact convexity and slot/feature dimensions are CAD matters.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Gill tips establish the widest extent rather than the body.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind images show gills reaching laterally beyond the head and paws; overall millimeter envelope is separately measured.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Three charcoal horns: smaller middle horn and taller outer pair.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind hero and signature show a small center cone flanked by two taller dark cones on the head.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Eight charcoal dorsal spikes along the eight body barrels.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind image shows a continuous line of eight dark cones on the tapering chain, one on each visible segment.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Raised coral tail fan with five rooted lobes, tallest feature.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind read called this an upright branching coral/leaf-like tail. The silhouette has five joined lobes and rises above the head horns and all dorsal cones. A flat fan is consistent with the stated tail construction.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Happy face with two dark domed eyes, white highlights, nostrils, a smiling mouth and coral tongue.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind cheerful face shows two projecting round dark eyes with white highlights, two tiny nostrils and an open dark smile containing a coral tongue.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Sleepy face with the same cheek outline and nostrils, closed charcoal lids and small charcoal mouth.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind signature read explicitly recognized peaceful sleeping expression: curved closed lids, paired nostrils and small round mouth on the matching cheek plate.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: At least happy and sleepy expressions, each shown installed on the same animal.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The two canonical signature panels show the same body geometry with visibly different happy and sleepy installed plates; no transition animation is supplied or inferred.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Mint body/head/legs, cream face/belly, coral gills/tail/tongue, charcoal horns/spikes/claws/eyes/mouth, white highlights.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind read noted the coherent mint, pale cream, pink and dark palette. All visible color roles align; exact hex values and no-paint/separate-filament manufacture require source/export evidence.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Ball-joint family appearance between body sections, head and tail; no separate pin hinges, loose pins or rod-through bores.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind read noted segmentation suggestive of bendability, not pin hinges. No pin-hinge heads or inserted rods are visibly presented. The separate pink ball-ended kit pieces read as the disclosed coupon pieces after reveal. Hidden joint geometry and retained mobility cannot be proved visually.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Magnetic face with matching three-pocket interface, indexing rim, and no friction-retention claim.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind signature shows common outline and seating rim in both states; post-reveal rear-oblique view shows three circular recesses on the spare face back. Source specifies magnets, but hidden head pockets, pocket coordinates, magnetic force and non-friction retention are not visual verdicts.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Small tolerance coupon carrying a real-size ball/socket example and magnet pocket.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind hero identified one rectangular mint socket plate and two pink ball-ended blocks beside the creature. After reveal these match the intended coupon kit presentation. Actual dimensions and tolerance qualification need measurement/physical tests.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Symmetric animal inside the requested envelope, with gills providing width and tail providing height.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind views show paired horns/gills and a centered tapering body; bottom view confirms bilateral paws. Head/body/gill/tail relative placement matches the requested spatial organization. Exact 133 by 169 by 93 mm fit is separately documented.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Printed color-separated components rather than a painted single object; no unwanted base, motor, battery or drive in the stated concept.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Visible component boundaries and discrete colored inserts are consistent with separate parts. No base or powered drive is visible. Printed color process and absence of hidden hardware are source-level facts, not rendered proof.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Keep the animal coherent rather than a set of disconnected decorations.
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Initial apparent foot detachment is preserved in the blind record. The unchanged-geometry supplemental underside views show leg/body continuity and supported belly patches. Gills, horns, spikes, face and tail remain consistently related to one creature.

largest_risk: Functional joint travel, friction pose holding, snap recovery, magnetic retention and adhesive strength remain unverified. The primary initial visual concern was apparently detached feet; it required supplemental views and must not be erased from the blind record.
resolution: Retain the initial blind concern in BLIND-REVIEW-r1.json. The post-reveal bottom and rear-oblique views of unchanged geometry resolve the visible attachment concern; separately supplied geometric audit reports real two-plane contacts. Accept the held form and two-expression visual signature only. Keep motion and physical performance UNVERIFIED and print_ready_claim false.

separate_nonvisual_requirements.geometry_and_dimensions: Root reports exact kit75 valid solids, zero clashes over216 tested pairs at1mm3 threshold; both exact expression states valid/zero reported clashes; neutral figure133x168.593784x93mm. These are supplied CAD facts, not independent image measurements.
separate_nonvisual_requirements.leg_contacts: Root and decor_parts supplied exact two-plane adhesive contacts, front44.325mm2 each and rear21.623mm2 each, zero gap/plastic overlap to owner halves. Post-reveal views support the contact placement visually; no adhesive performance verified.
separate_nonvisual_requirements.joint_requirements: Ball9..12mm, .25mm diametral cavity clearance, .6mm retention undercut, >=2mm socket wall, slit finger count, joint family, neck/clearances and pose range require source and deterministic evidence. Motion is UNVERIFIED; no range, capture, friction or insertion pass inferred.
separate_nonvisual_requirements.face_requirements: PocketD8.15,depth1.2,8x1 magnets, .2 recess, coordinates(-17,6),(17,6),(0,-13), matching datums and >=1.2 wall require CAD evidence. Magnetic retention, polarity, adhesive bond and physical swapping untested.
separate_nonvisual_requirements.printing_requirements: Support-free orientation,45degree overhang target,no joint-gap bridging/no internal supports,1.2mm walls,.8mm features,.4nozzle,.2layers and220mm bed require gate/orientation evidence. No successful printing, tool-free snapping or print-readiness claim.
separate_nonvisual_requirements.part_economy: Seventy-five physical pieces and adhesive construction seams are disclosed. Visual stills cannot establish that every split is the minimum necessary; no additional visual defect is inferred solely from piece count.
separate_nonvisual_requirements.authorization_scope: Root states user authorized a disclosed unverified prototype after exhausted/cancelled checks. This review applies that limited prototype scope and does not change unverified function into a passed requirement.
